TensorFlow.js 4.22.0 and TensorFlow.js COCO-SSD 2.2.3

See LICENSE and PROVENANCE.json for the complete license, source URLs and checksums.

The original unmodified TensorFlow.js lite_mobilenet_v2 COCO-SSD graph and weights
are provided for local browser inference. The model recognizes 80 general COCO
classes. It has not been retrained for industrial equipment or defects.
No test photograph is redistributed in this directory.
